cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And whose cleaning method we use all year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's ask the whole club to witness the clarification.
